title: Component Maturity Lifecycle: Alpha to Deprecated
subtopicTitle: Component Maturity Lifecycle: Alpha to Deprecated
problemStatement:
Establishing clear maturity tiers (Proposal, Alpha, Beta, Stable, Deprecated) to balance fast innovation with enterprise stability.

**Enterprise Importance**:
Without a structured lifecycle, feature teams either fork components or complain that the design system team moves too slowly.
interviewTrap: Releasing unvetted components directly as 'Stable', then introducing breaking changes 2 weeks later.

detailedExplanation.conceptualOverview: Components graduate through defined quality gates: Proposal (RFC) -> Alpha (internal testing) -> Beta (opt-in pilot) -> Stable (100% test & a11y coverage) -> Deprecated (with codemod migration).
stepByStepWalkthrough: 1. Design Token Layer: Primitives, semantic aliases, and component tokens established.
2. Component Architecture: Headless state and keyboard accessibility hooks implemented.
3. Styling & Cascade: Zero-runtime CSS variables and layer specificity managed.
4. Governance & Packaging: Tree-shaking, semantic versioning, and telemetry monitored.
detailedExplanation.underlyingEngineInternals:
## 🏛️ Component Maturity Lifecycle

Enterprise design systems use a standardized maturity rubric:

```
[ 1. Proposal (RFC) ] -> [ 2. Alpha (Lab) ] -> [ 3. Beta ] -> [ 4. Stable ] -> [ 5. Deprecated ]
```

| Stage | Package / Location | SLA / Guarantee | Breaking Changes? |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Proposal** | GitHub Discussion / RFC | Concept review | N/A |
| **Alpha / Lab** | `@ds/lab` | Experimental, early feedback | Frequent, zero deprecation notice |
| **Beta** | `@ds/react/beta` | Feature complete, real pilot testing | Allowed in minor bumps |
| **Stable** | `@ds/react` | 100% a11y, visual tests, semver | Only in Major bumps with 6-month notice |
| **Deprecated** | `@ds/react` | Maintenance only, provides codemod | No new features, scheduled for removal |
